summary: Full review of new B2B Sectors feature (backend + frontend) with regression on pre-existing flows. 15/15 backend pytest tests pass. All frontend scenarios validated: navbar link, Home sectors section (3 cards + Ver todas), /soluciones listing (3 cards), /soluciones/:slug with headline / 5 usecases / 3 metrics / demo placeholder (since PICKAXE_DEPLOYMENT_SECTOR_* are empty) / WhatsApp window.open targeting /api/whatsapp?text=..._blank / Solicitar demo personalizada → /?demo=<Sector> which auto-opens the budget modal with plan = 'Demo personalizada · <Sector>' and pre-filled mensaje, and URL is cleaned. 404 for unknown slug renders sector-page-error. Regression on /, /agentes, /legal, /admin plus /api/, /api/reviews, /api/captcha, /api/admin/login all OK.
action_items: No action required for this iteration. When Pickaxe deployment IDs are filled into PICKAXE_DEPLOYMENT_SECTOR_INMOBILIARIAS/_DENTAL/_BEAUTY, re-test that the iframe (data-testid='sector-pickaxe-mount') replaces the placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~2965 lines; consider splitting into page-level components (HomePage, SolucionesIndexPage, SectorPage, AdminPage) for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).
React warning in console: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority (did you mean fetchPriority?)' — likely on an or . Minor; does not break anything.

The WhatsApp CTA is implemented as a <button> with onClick window.open(...). Semantically an <a href={whatsappUrl} target=_blank rel=noopener> would be slightly better for accessibility and mouse middle-click / right-click 'Copy link' behaviour, but current impl satisfies the functional requirement.
_public_sector correctly strips 'deployment_env' and only adds 'deployment_id' on detail — good separation.
openBudget uses window.location.href causing a full page reload. Functional and simple, but a React-Router navigation + state prop would be smoother (nit).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Sectors are defined in-code via SECTOR_CATALOGUE constant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_sectors_and_regression.py covers: GET /api/sectors list (no deployment_id leakage), GET /api/sectors/{slug} detail (with deployment_id key, empty while env vars unset), 404 unknown slug, + core regression (root, reviews, captcha, admin login OK and bad creds). Frontend paths tested: /, /soluciones, /soluciones/inmobiliarias|clinicas-dentales|salones-belleza, /soluciones/agente-inexistente, /?demo=Inmobiliarias. Note the Home promo-modal (data-testid='promo-modal') auto-opens and overlays the UI on fresh loads; close it via '.modal-close' before interacting with the Home. The budget plan is rendered as text inside a <strong> element after 'Plan seleccionado:' (NOT an <input>/<select>), so assert via strong.textContent, not input.value. WhatsApp CTA is a <button> using window.open; to verify the URL in tests, stub window.open first and inspect the recorded call.
